newsitem.title: USA: Hearings set on Con Edison restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Hearings set on Con Edison restructuring.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commission said Thursday it has scheduled a series of open consumer education forums and public statement hearings to seek consumer views on an electric rate and restructuring settlement plan reached with Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc.

The proposed plan, agreed to by the utility, Department of Public Service Staff and several other parties, was filed in response to the commission's efforts to develop a new framework for the electric industry in New York state.
The commission noted it will decide whether to approve the plan following review of the information presented at evidentiary and public statement hearings.
The commission said it scheduled five hearings in New York City on May 7 and 8 and one in White Plains on May 6.
